upload.dropzone: PDF oder DOCX hier ablegen oder zur Auswahl klicken
upload.hint: Die Fakten werden extrahiert, überprüft und Ihren Erinnerungen hinzugefügt.
upload.discardTitle: Original nach der Extraktion löschen. Nur die abgeleiteten Erinnerungen behalten.
upload.discardWarning: Die hochgeladene Datei wird gelöscht, sobald ihre Fakten extrahiert wurden. Nur die überprüften Erinnerungen bleiben erhalten. Dies kann nicht rückgängig gemacht werden.

state.error: Extraktion fehlgeschlagen. Die Datei konnte nicht gelesen werden.

note.error: Diese Notiz konnte gerade nicht geladen werden.

file.error: Diese Dateiquelle konnte nicht geladen werden.
file.discardedNote: Das Original wurde nach der Extraktion verworfen. Nur die abgeleiteten Erinnerungen bleiben erhalten. Die Herkunft ist vollständig, es gibt nichts herunterzuladen.

conversation.error: Die Unterhaltung konnte nicht geladen werden.
conversation.lead: Aus Ihrer Unterhaltung: <title>{{title}}</title>. Die hervorgehobene Nachricht ist die Quelle. Benachbarte Beiträge werden als Kontext angezeigt.

email.error: Diese E-Mail konnte nicht geladen werden.
email.originallyFrom: Ursprünglich von: <sender>{{sender}}</sender>. Eine Antwort geht an diese Person, nicht an die weiterleitende Person.
email.forwardUnknownSender: Diese Nachricht wurde weitergeleitet. Der ursprüngliche Absender konnte nicht ermittelt werden, daher müssen Sie den Empfänger einer Antwort selbst eintragen.
email.draftCreated: Entwurf erstellt. Prüfen Sie ihn auf der Seite <link>Genehmigungen</link> und senden Sie ihn anschließend aus Ihrem eigenen E-Mail-Programm. Cogeto sendet nie E-Mails.
email.draftExplainer: Cogeto schreibt eine vorgeschlagene Antwort, die Sie bearbeiten und selbst senden können. Es sendet nie E-Mails. Sie genehmigen und senden aus Ihrem eigenen Programm.

web.error: Diese Webquelle konnte nicht geladen werden.
web.fetched: Abgerufen {{when}}. Die Fakten dieser Seite gelten für diesen Zeitpunkt.

Löschen?
delete.confirmWithFiles:

Löschen?
delete.impact: Beim Löschen dieser Quelle werden sie und {{memories}} dauerhaft entfernt. Ein signierter Beleg dient als Nachweis.
delete.impactWithFiles: Beim Löschen dieser Quelle werden sie, {{memories}} und {{files}} dauerhaft entfernt. Ein signierter Beleg dient als Nachweis.

read.title: What Cogeto read

outcome.needs_vision: Needs reading by a vision model

reason.row_cap_sheet: This file is longer than the per-sheet row limit, so Cogeto read the first rows of each sheet.
reason.row_cap_file: This file is longer than the row limit for one file, so Cogeto stopped once the limit was reached.
reason.no_text: Cogeto found no readable text in this file. Nothing was extracted, and nothing was invented.
reason.unsupported_type: Cogeto does not read this kind of file yet.
reason.legacy_office_format: This is a pre-2007 Office file. Save it as .docx or .xlsx and upload it again.
reason.parse_failed: The file is of a kind Cogeto reads, but these bytes could not be parsed. It may be corrupt or password protected.
reason.parse_timeout: Reading this file took too long and was stopped.
reason.text_over_cap: This file expands to more text than Cogeto reads from one document.
reason.undecodable_text: The text in this file could not be decoded.
reason.vision_unavailable: Some pages are pictures. Reading them needs a vision model, which this instance does not have working. Nothing was invented for those pages; the original is kept, so they can be read once it is available.
reason.vision_cap_reached: This document reached its limit for pages read by a vision model. The pages beyond it were left unread rather than silently skipped.
reason.vision_failed: A page needed a vision model and the attempt failed. The original is kept and can be read again.
reason.no_readable_text: Cogeto could not find readable text on this document, by any means available to it. Nothing was extracted, and nothing was invented.

read.valuesUnavailable_one: {{count}} cells had no stored value, so they were left out rather than guessed.
read.valuesUnavailable_other: {{count}} cells had no stored value, so they were left out rather than guessed.

tier.title: How each page was read
tier.visionPages_one: {{count}} pages were read by a vision model.
tier.visionPages_other: {{count}} pages were read by a vision model.

reprocess.explainer: The original is kept, so this can be read again once the missing capability is available. Facts already stored are reconciled, not duplicated.
reprocess.queued: Queued. The document will be read again in the background.
reprocess.noBytes: The original was discarded after extraction, so there is nothing left to read again.

anchor.title: Document context
anchor.none: No context was detected for this document.
anchor.detected: Detected automatically from the document opening.
anchor.edited: Corrected by you. Automatic anchoring will not overwrite it.
anchor.saveHint: Saved. Reprocess the file to re-anchor its facts to the corrected context.

page.uploadIntro: The deliberate way in: documents you intend to keep and audit. Files also attach in chat with the paperclip; either way they go through the same pipeline.

list.searchPlaceholder: Search sources by name or content...
list.error: We couldn't load your sources just now.

firstRun.what: A source is anything Cogeto has read: a document, a note, an email, a chat capture, a web page.
firstRun.how: Attach a file or say "remember this" in chat, or add a document with the upload action above.

detail.error: We couldn't load this source's facts just now.
detail.noFacts: No facts were extracted from this source.
detail.noLocation: No location recorded: this fact was admitted before span locators existed. Reprocess the source to locate it.
detail.gateRefused: The extraction gate withheld this source: {{reason}}.
detail.suppressedExplainer: What Cogeto decided not to trust, with the reason. Demoted facts were admitted as uncertain; withheld ones were never stored as memories.

event.party_superseded: a fact was superseded, the finding follows its successor
event.kept_open: kept open, could not be safely closed

imports.intro: Many documents at once: a folder, a ZIP archive, or an S3 style path. You see the full list before anything is ingested.
imports.missingFile: The file {{name}} is no longer available in the browser. Pick the folder again.
imports.zipExplainer: Pick a ZIP archive. Its contents are listed first; nothing is ingested until you confirm.
imports.zipDropzone: Drop a ZIP archive here, or click to choose one
imports.folderExplainer: Pick a folder. The file list is prepared in your browser and shown before any upload happens.

s3.explainer: List objects from an S3 compatible endpoint. The credentials are used to list and copy the files and are never stored.

manifest.title: What will happen
manifest.summary: {{included}} files will be ingested. {{duplicates}} already stored (skipped), {{unsupported}} unsupported.
manifest.revisionCandidates_one: {{count}} look like newer versions of documents you already have.
manifest.revisionCandidates_other: {{count}} look like newer versions of documents you already have.
manifest.scopeHelp: One choice for the whole import: every fact extracted from these documents lands with this scope. Individual facts can still be changed afterwards.

run.title: Import: {{label}}
run.pausedDailyCap: Paused: the daily upload limit is reached. The import continues automatically when the limit resets. Nothing was skipped.
run.noItems: No matching files in this import.

notice.absent: This page is no longer listed upstream. The source and its facts remain until you delete them.
notice.archived: This page was archived upstream. The source and its facts remain until you delete them.

revisions.heading: Document versions
revisions.none: No version links. When a newer version of this document is imported, the link is recorded or proposed here.
revisions.supersedes: This document replaces an earlier version.
revisions.supersededBy: A newer version of this document exists.
revisions.basisAnchored: Basis: the document states revision {{to}}, the earlier one {{from}}.
revisions.pickerExplainer: Pick the document this one replaces. The link is recorded as your decision.
